title: Naringin targets JAK1-mediated M2 polarization of macrophages to promote the osteogenic effect of induced membrane technique.
authors: Li, Shuyuan; Ye, Jinfei; Yang, Dawen; Cai, Qunbin; Zeng, Zhanpeng; Zhou, Qishi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究柚皮苷通过JAK1/STAT6通路调控巨噬细胞M2极化促进成骨，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Induced membrane technique (IMT), a novel approach for reconstructing critical-size bone defect, encounters the challenge of lengthy mineralization time after bone grafting. This study is to explore the effect of Naringin on M2 macrophage polarization-mediated osteogenesis in the induced membrane's bone graft area. METHODS: The IMT model was established in SD rats. After 8 weeks of treatment with Naringin and interleukin-4 (IL-4), the repair effect of femoral bone defects was evaluated. Meanwhile, RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) was performed on the bone tissue from rats treated with Naringin to detect changes in gene transcription levels. In vitro, Macrophages were divided into four groups: Control group, si-JAK1 + Naringin group, Naringin group and IL-4 group. At corresponding stages, cell proliferation, cell phenotype (M1 or M2), factors related to the JAK/STAT6 pathway, and osteogenic factors secreted by macrophages were assessed. Additionally, a macrophage-osteoblast coculture system was established to analyze the effects of osteogenic factors derived from M2 macrophages on osteoblasts' viability and mineralization. RESULTS: The result of RNA-seq on the bone tissue in the bone graft area revealed that genes upregulated by Naringin were significantly enriched in biological processes related to immune regulation and the JAK/STAT pathway. The in vivo study indicated that there is an increase in markers of M1 macrophages and a decrease in markers of M2 macrophages in the bone grafting area of IMT. Treatment with Naringin and IL-4 could stimulate the polarization of M0 macrophages towards M2, accelerate the healing of bone defects, and increase expression of osteogenic factors and JAK1/STAT6 pathway factors. The in vitro experiments showed that treatment of primitive macrophages (M0) with Naringin and IL-4 led to an increase in the number of M2 macrophages, enhanced secretion of osteogenic factors, upregulation of the JAK1/STAT6 pathway. Conversely, the number of M1 macrophages decreased. Additionally, si-JAK1 was able to reverse the positive effect of Naringin on M2 macrophage polarization. Furthermore, after co-culturing macrophages and osteoblasts, it was found that osteogenic factors derived from polarization of M2 macrophages could stimulate the activity and mineralization of osteoblasts. Finally, Molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation (MDS) and CETSA results indicated that Naringin can directly bind to JAK1 protein in macrophages and maintain its thermal stability. CONCLUSIONS: JAK1-mediated polarization of M0 macrophages towards M2 has a positive regulatory function in osteoblasts' mineralization. Naringin targets JAK1 in macrophages within the IMT's bone graft area, maintaining its stability, promoting the activation and phosphorylation of the JAK1/STAT6 pathway, stimulating M2 polarization of macrophages, and thereby facilitating bone graft growth and accelerating the repair of large bone defects.
abstract_zh: 背景：诱导膜技术（IMT）是一种重建临界尺寸骨缺损的新方法，但面临骨移植后矿化时间较长的挑战。本研究旨在探讨柚皮苷对诱导膜骨移植区域中M2巨噬细胞极化介导成骨作用的影响。方法：在SD大鼠中建立IMT模型。经柚皮苷和白细胞介素-4（IL-4）治疗8周后，评估股骨骨缺损的修复效果。同时，对柚皮苷处理的大鼠骨组织进行RNA测序（RNA-seq），以检测基因转录水平的变化。体外实验中，将巨噬细胞分为四组：对照组、si-JAK1+柚皮苷组、柚皮苷组和IL-4组。在相应阶段，评估细胞增殖、细胞表型（M1或M2）、与JAK/STAT6通路相关的因子以及巨噬细胞分泌的成骨因子。此外，建立巨噬细胞-成骨细胞共培养系统，分析M2巨噬细胞来源的成骨因子对成骨细胞活力和矿化的影响。结果：对骨移植区域骨组织的RNA-seq结果显示，柚皮苷上调的基因显著富集于与免疫调节和JAK/STAT通路相关的生物学过程。体内研究表明，IMT骨移植区域中M1巨噬细胞标志物增加，而M2巨噬细胞标志物减少。柚皮苷和IL-4治疗可刺激M0巨噬细胞向M2极化，加速骨缺损愈合，并增加成骨因子和JAK1/STAT6通路因子的表达。体外实验显示，用柚皮苷和IL-4处理原始巨噬细胞（M0）导致M2巨噬细胞数量增加，成骨因子分泌增强，JAK1/STAT6通路上调。相反，M1巨噬细胞数量减少。此外，si-JAK1能够逆转柚皮苷对M2巨噬细胞极化的积极作用。进一步地，在巨噬细胞和成骨细胞共培养后，发现M2巨噬细胞极化来源的成骨因子可刺激成骨细胞的活性和矿化。最后，分子对接、分子动力学模拟（MDS）和CETSA结果表明，柚皮苷可直接结合巨噬细胞中的JAK1蛋白并维持其热稳定性。结论：JAK1介导的M0巨噬细胞向M2极化对成骨细胞矿化具有正向调节功能。柚皮苷靶向IMT骨移植区域巨噬细胞中的JAK1，维持其稳定性，促进JAK1/STAT6通路的激活和磷酸化，刺激巨噬细胞M2极化，从而促进骨移植生长并加速大段骨缺损的修复。
